items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: But these guys played what they called bop I guess, Sonny Berman and Red Rodney, they were some superb players.

ctx.x: I mean that’s phenomenal. But most of those bop guys were corny, man, they didn’t swing or anything. It just sounded like they didn’t know what they were doing. And I don’t think they did. No these guys were superb, you know, superb. But these guys played what they called bop I guess, Sonny Berman and Red Rodney, they were some superb players. But the other guys that played the bop thing that I was associated with was corny man, it was corny. It was awful, Jesus.
Well you eventually went and played with Marian.
